name: Tana
desc: Supertag outliner with an agentic AI workspace layer
desc_zh: 以 supertag 为核心的大纲工具，叠加 Agent 式 AI 工作区
solves: Notes become a pile of flat text nobody can query. Tana makes every fact a supertag, so the AI can work with them.
solves_zh: 笔记会变成一堆没人能查询的扁平文本。Tana 把每条事实做成 supertag，让 AI 能直接处理。
best_for: When you want a personal knowledge base that answers questions instead of storing pages.
best_for_zh: 当你想要一个能回答问题、而不只是存放页面的个人知识库。
